name: Vendor Evaluation
description: Produces a vendor evaluation scorecard with weighted criteria, scoring guide, vendor comparison, and recommendation using weighted scoring methodology. Use when the user asks to evaluate vendors, compare suppliers, build a vendor selection scorecard, create an RFP evaluation matrix, or make a structured vendor selection decision. Do NOT use for competitive market analysis (use competitive-analysis), partnership agreement structuring (use partnership-agreement-outline), or procurement contract review (requires legal review).
